class.name: Priest
class.text: Cloth, mana and a wand. Smite and Lesser Heal are yours from the start, Shadow Word: Pain comes at 4, Power Word: Shield at 6, Renew and Fade at 8. At 10 you get Mind Blast and your first talent point. Every line below says what to put on first, what to cast and when to let the wand work.

card.caresAbout: mana, the wand, which pain is on the monster, and who is shielded
card.vocabulary: shield, pain, blast, wand, renew, heal, drink, cast, fade
card.soundsLike: calm and a little dry, a trainer who asks whether the shield is up before asking what you will cast. A priest line says what to put on first, then what to cast
card.neverSays: faith, gods, prayer as a belief, anything about the Light, and none of the class's lore
card.test: could it be read while the cast bar fills?

advice.say: Shadow is the build this page advises, because it kills alone with the wand and Shadowform at 42 halves the mana of your Shadow spells. The price: you cannot heal in Shadowform, and mana is thin until Spirit Tap. Discipline levels the same way, and how fast is not settled.

Discipline is the healer this page advises, because it levels with the same wand and Pain as Shadow and heals a tank with shields and Penance. The price: you have no cheap area heal until Prayer of Healing at 30. Holy heals a group with Prayer of Mending, and it levels slowly alone.

overview.who: You heal, shield and curse, with a wand in your hand when mana runs short. The craft is mana: a Priest wins a fight by what it does not cast.
overview.good: Staying alive. A shield, a heal over time and a scream cover most mistakes, and Shadow Word: Pain tags a monster from range. In a group the others lean on you.
overview.bad: Mana, and speed. You have little health and no escape but Psychic Scream and Fade, and a long fight runs you dry. Two monsters at once is the usual way a Priest dies.
overview.resource: Mana. Your wand costs none and does not stop your mana coming back, so end fights with it. Spirit Tap returns mana after a kill, and Meditation lets half your regeneration run while you cast.
overview.levelling: Shield yourself, pull with Mind Blast, add Pain and finish with the wand. Shadow kills alone with the wand, Discipline levels the same way and how fast is not settled, and Holy is slow alone and made for dungeons.
overview.ten: You get your first talent point and pick a spec. All three take Wand Specialization first. Shadow kills alone with the wand, Discipline heals a tank and levels the same way, Holy is for dungeons, and a respec costs gold.

damage.reason: Shadow kills alone with the wand. Shadowform comes at 42 here and halves the mana of every Shadow spell.

heal.reason: Discipline levels with the same wand and Pain as Shadow and heals a tank with shields and Penance. Holy is the other healer, for dungeons.

builds.name: Shadow
builds.intro: Shadow wins with Pain, Plague and Mind Blast and ends fights with the wand. Spirit Tap returns your mana after kills, Mind Flay replaces Smite, and Shadowform at 42 makes every Shadow spell half price and harder hitting. It is the common choice for levelling a Priest alone.
builds.line: Pain, Plague and Mind Blast, then the wand. It kills alone, and there are no heals in Shadowform.
builds.pathNote: (37 points in Shadow, then 14 in Discipline: the wand first, and Twin Disciplines, Mental Strength and Meditation at the end.)
builds.split: when to take Shadowform and what follows it. One order respecs at 40 to reach it at once, or skips Wand Specialization to have it at 40. Another goes through Discipline to 30 and takes it at 54. The order here takes the wand first and Shadowform at 42, with Devouring Contagion and Early Demise in place of Blackout.
builds.dry: The wand is your cheapest damage, so a full mana bar is a choice.

sources.label: Icy Veins, Shadow Priest levelling (2 November 2026)

path.why: Your wand does 25% more damage. It costs no mana, so most early kills end with it.
Kills sometimes double your Spirit for 15 seconds, and half your mana regeneration continues while you cast for that time. It is why you drink so little.
Shadow Word: Pain lasts 6 seconds longer. More damage for the same mana, on a monster you leave to the wand.
Your Shadow spells miss less. A miss costs the same mana as a hit, so this pays you back at once.
A channelled spell that slows the monster by half. It replaces Smite as the spell you cast between Mind Blasts.
Each tick of Mind Flay hits harder than the one before it, so a full channel is worth waiting for.
Mind Blast comes back sooner. It is your hardest hit, so a shorter wait is more damage.
You and your party heal for part of the Shadow damage you do. It is also the way down to Shadowform.
Each Shadow spell makes the monster take more Shadow damage from you, up to 5 times. The longer the fight, the more it pays.
Mind Blast comes back sooner. It is your hardest hit, so a shorter wait is more damage.
Silences a caster for 5 seconds and cuts its cast short. It is your one interrupt, so keep it for the spell that hurts.
Mind Blast comes back sooner. At full ranks it is ready 2.5 seconds earlier than it was.
Your Shadow spells reach 20% further. More range is more free casts before the monster arrives.
10% more Shadow damage at full ranks. It is the biggest plain damage gain in the tree, and it sits just before Shadowform.
Shadow damage up 10%, Shadow spells cost half, critical hits hit harder and physical damage falls by 15%. You cannot cast heals in it.
Your Shadow spells miss less. By now every cast is a Shadow spell, so a miss costs you more than anywhere else.
Devouring Plague costs half, and when its target dies the plague jumps to 2 monsters nearby. Plague the one that will die first.
Your instant spells hit harder. Pain, Plague and Death are all instant, so most of your damage over time grows.
More Intellect, which is more mana and a little more critical chance.
Half your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast. Spirit then works in a fight and not only between them.
Shadow Word: Death crits more often on a monster at 20% health or less. It is your finisher, so it should kill.
More Intellect, which is more mana and a little more critical chance.

builds.name: Discipline
builds.intro: Discipline levels like Shadow, with Pain, Mind Blast and the wand, and keeps a shield in reserve. Penance at 35, then Renewed Hope and Divine Aegis, make it a tank healer. How fast it levels alone is not settled, and it heals well.
builds.line: Shields, Penance and a wand. Levels like Shadow, and heals a tank.
builds.pathNote: (31 points in Discipline, 15 in Holy for Holy Specialization, Twilight Focus and Inspiration, 5 in Shadow for Spirit Tap.)
builds.split: whether to keep Spirit Tap and the wand. The 30 to 60 order used here keeps both. A level 60 build drops them for 20 points in Holy, which costs a respec. Another order delays Spirit Tap to reach Penance sooner.
builds.dry: A shield on the tank is a hit you do not have to heal.

sources.label: Mobalytics, Discipline Priest beta guide (2 November 2026)
Warcraft Tavern, Discipline Priest (Forever, 15 October build)
Icy Veins, Discipline Priest levelling (16 October 2026)

Your instant spells deal and heal more. Renew, Pain and Plague are instant, so it helps both halves of the build.
More Intellect, which is more mana and a little more critical chance.
Half your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast. A healer casts all the time, so this is the mana talent that matters most.
Your next spell costs nothing and crits more often. Put it on Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing when the big hit comes.

Power Word: Shield costs 15% less and comes back 4 seconds sooner. A shield you can recast often is the point of this tree.
Smite, Holy Fire and instant spells cost less. Shield and Renew are instant, so your healing costs less too.
A volley that hurts an enemy or heals an ally, three times in 2 seconds. Cast it whenever it is ready, on a tank or on a monster.
Your single-target heals crit more on a target wearing Weakened Soul, and shorten it. Shield the tank, then heal into the shield.
A critical heal puts a shield on the target for 12 seconds. Renewed Hope makes your crits more common, so it fires often.

builds.name: Holy
builds.intro: Holy heals with Renew, Heal and Prayer of Mending. Divine Fury makes Smite and Heal quicker, Holy Nova is the only area spell early, and Prayer of Mending at 47 is its signature. It is the dungeon healer, and it levels slowly alone.
builds.line: Renew, Heal and Prayer of Mending. A dungeon healer, slow alone.
builds.pathNote: (32 points in Holy, 14 in Discipline and 5 in Shadow for the wand and mana.)
builds.split: where to start. The order used here opens with the wand and Spirit Tap to level. Other orders skip them for Twilight Focus and Improved Renew, and the healing plans for dungeons do the same.
builds.dry: A heal that overheals is mana you drink again.

Icy Veins, Holy Priest levelling (16 October 2026)

path.why: Your wand does 25% more damage. It costs no mana, so most early kills end with it.
Kills sometimes double your Spirit for 15 seconds, and half your mana regeneration continues while you cast for that time. It is why you drink so little.
Your spells keep their cast time when you are hit, most of the time. Pushback ends more heals than any monster does.
Renew heals more. It is the heal you put on the tank before the pull, so it gains from every rank you add.
Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal cast half a second faster. That is a big part of a Heal's cast time, and the heal lands sooner.
Hurts every monster within 10 yards and heals your party. It is the only area damage spell a levelling Priest has.
Renew heals more. It is the heal you put on the tank before the pull, so it gains from every rank you add.
A critical heal raises the target's armour for 15 seconds. It helps the tank, and it costs you nothing.
Flash Heal on someone else also heals you for half as much, and makes no threat. Healing the tank keeps you up too.
Smite, Holy Fire, Holy Nova and Prayer of Healing reach 10% further. A cheap point on the way to the lower talents.
Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance and Prayer of Mending cost less mana. Your big heals are your mana bill, so this is the saving.
Part of your Spirit becomes healing and damage. You already stack Spirit for mana, so it works twice.
All your healing is a little stronger. Nothing clever, and it counts on every heal you cast.
If you die you heal for 15 seconds at no mana cost. It also opens the way to Prayer of Mending.
You regain mana when a heal differs from your last one. Alternate Renew, Flash Heal and Heal and the mana comes back.
Heals the target the next time it takes damage, then jumps to another party member, up to 5 times. Cast it on the tank whenever it is ready.
You regain mana when a heal differs from your last one. Alternate Renew, Flash Heal and Heal and the mana comes back.
Your instant spells deal and heal more. Renew is instant, so it helps the heal you cast the most.
More Intellect, which is more mana and a little more critical chance.
Half your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast. A healer casts all the time, so this is the mana talent that matters most.
Your next spell costs nothing and crits more often. Put it on Greater Heal or Prayer of Healing when the big hit comes.
